name: Console Mono and Sans
description: JetBrains Mono for display, labels, captions, code, and numerals, over Inter for prose.

provenance.attribution: JetBrains Mono and Inter, by their project authors, self-hosted from their pinned npm packages for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.copyright: Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors (https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono); Copyright 2016 The Inter Project Authors (https://github.com/rsms/inter)
provenance.maintainer: The upstream projects, at the versions fonts.provenance.json pins
provenance.derivation: Role metrics by the platform for the mission-control direction (packs-plan §3.2); font files copied unmodified from @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono 5.3.0 and @fontsource-variable/inter 5.3.0, never subset or renamed inside.

fallbacks: Each shipped family is followed by metric-matched fallback faces over local system fonts (size-adjust and ascent, descent, and line-gap overrides), then a system stack and a generic family.
There's a fallback face at each weight the roles set, over the system bold for a heading.
Glyphs outside every shipped face's unicode-range render in the declared system stack, so text never goes missing.
caveats: Both families ship upright only, the two variable Latin files filling most of the ceiling, so em renders as a slanted face.
The latin-ext subsets, 100,264 B together, load only on a page whose text needs them, such as ő or ł; a Latin page loads 88,660 B. Other scripts render in the declared system stack.
